name: Lunch With the Groteskians
source:
Hello grounder! You have been invited to have a lunch with the Groteskians. Just don't mind those little things nibbling your toes...

[From [url=https://melancholiczombie.itch.io/lunch-with-the-groteskians]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
地面人，你好！你受邀与Groteskians共进午餐。只要别在意那些啃你脚趾的小东西就行……

[来源：[url=https://melancholiczombie.itch.io/lunch-with-the-groteskians]Itch.io[/url]]
